description: Source code for FilesBackupManager class managing file backups, including enabling/disabling backups, changing backup location, saving and reading backup files, and handling backup metadata.

classes.name: FilesBackupManager
classes.description: Manages file backup operations including enabling/disabling backups, changing backup location, saving backup files, and reading backup chunks.

methods.name: isFilesBackupsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether file backups are enabled.

methods.name: enableFilesBackups
methods.description: Enables file backups and initializes backup location and mapping.

methods.name: changeFilesBackupsLocation
methods.description: Prompts user to select a new backup location and transfers existing backups.

methods.name: transferFilesBackupsToNewLocation
methods.description: Transfers backup files to a new location and updates mapping.

methods.name: getMappingFileLocation
methods.description: Constructs path to backup mapping file.

methods.name: getMappingFileFromDisk
methods.description: Reads backup mapping file from disk.

methods.name: getFilesBackupsMappingFile
methods.description: Retrieves and processes backup mapping data.

methods.name: openFilesBackupsLocation
methods.description: Opens backup location in system file explorer.

methods.name: saveFilesBackupsMappingFile
methods.description: Saves backup mapping data to disk.

methods.name: saveFilesBackupsFile
methods.description: Saves a backup file with metadata and updates mapping.

methods.name: getFileBackupReadToken
methods.description: Creates a read token for backup file reading.

methods.name: readNextChunk
methods.description: Reads next chunk of backup file data.
